decision.rationale: The bounded generic L6 storage correction is verified: shared cross-process locking, operation-local reload/merge-on-write, and atomic replacement prevent stale process or same-instance reader races without introducing app-owned identity, meaning, thresholds, routes, providers, or Exit policy.

spine_substrate_test.evidence: The generic L6 version/runtime-ADG contracts and final 488-test integrated ADG repair workflow passed.

any_app_capability_test.evidence: The lock accepts only a base path and timeout; mapping writers operate on generic string identities without application branching.

app_owned_meaning_test.evidence: No application semantics moved into core; apps_rg remains a downstream consumer of generic storage.

no_app_literal_test.evidence: Exact scan across all three changed core paths found zero forbidden apps_* literals or app route/policy constants.

plugin_test.evidence: No plugin or new public provider surface was introduced; same-layer L6 imports passed F401/I and core static checks.

negative_control_test.evidence: Windows suite passed 56 tests covering spawned competing writers, observed live-writer contention against recovery, same-instance readers, timeout/crash release, manifest freshness, archive mismatch, ambiguous traces, and trace-less snapshot aliases.

platform_approval_test.evidence: The user explicitly authorized expansion with Expand and directed continued implementation, testing, commit, PR, and publication.

boundary_preservation_test.evidence: All three core paths classify as GENERIC_INFRASTRUCTURE; zero forbidden literals, scoped core-static 4/4, and ruff F401/I/S passed.

contract_compatibility_test.evidence: Public store interfaces remain unchanged; exact Windows store/backfill/provenance cohort passed 56 tests and the integrated cohort passed 488 tests.

runtime_proof_compatibility_test.evidence: Digest/provenance/runtime proof, handoff status consistency, and fail-closed manifest tests are included in the final 488-test integrated PASS.
